"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America condemns the forced resignation of the leaders of the Bolivia Senate and Chamber of Deputies on November 10.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America condemns the forced resignation of a host of government ministers on November 10.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All those who resigned were under personal threat of violence from right-wing opposition forces if they did not resign.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Evo Morales agreed to a new round of elections early on November 10 in an effort to defuse rising tension and political violence across the country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Evo Morales ultimately resigned later on November 10 after General Williams Kaliman publicly called for him to do so.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The call by General Williams Kaliman for Evo Morales to resign was a blatant and unacceptable encroachment of the military into Bolivia’s democratic system.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There are widespread reports of attacks against leaders and supporters of Morales’ political party, Movement Toward Socialism (MAS).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Leaders’ homes of Movement Toward Socialism (MAS) have been burned.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Vinto mayor Patricia Arce was physically assaulted by right-wing protestors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Wiphala (indigenous) flags were publicly burned.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"There are racially motivated threats and attacks against indigenous and campesino leaders.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
